summary: initializer phase complete; project is ready for coding
commands:
mkdir -p src/parser src/renderer src/cli
mkdir -p types/common
mkdir -p tests/unit
touch .gitignore
touch package.json tsconfig.json bun.lockb README.md
echo '{"name": "md-toc", "version": "0.1.0", "description": "CLI for Markdown Table of Contents generation.", "scripts": {"build": "bun run build:tsc", "start": "ts-node src/cli.ts"}, "dependencies": {}, "devDependencies": {} }' > package.json
echo '{ "compilerOptions": { "module": "NodeNext", "target": "ES2022", "rootDir": "./src", "outDir": "./dist", "esModuleInterop": true, "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true, "strict": true } }' > tsconfig.json
mkdir -p src/parser src/renderer src/cli src/slugger types/common tests/unit

git init && git add . && echo "node_modules/" >> .gitignore && echo "*.log" >> .gitignore && echo "./dist/" >> .gitignore && echo ".bun/cache/" >> .gitignore && git commit -m "chore: initialize project scaffolding and feature list"

bun run format || true # Attempt to format code if necessary

git status && git add . && git diff --staged && git commit -m "chore: complete initialization - ready for development"

echo "Running final initialization verification..."
ls .aidd/features/ | wc -l
find .aidd/features -name 'feature.json' -exec sh -c 'jq type "$1" | grep -q object || echo "INVALID"' _ {} \;
git status && git log -1

bun run format || true
git status && git add . && git diff --staged && git commit -m "chore: complete initialization - ready for development"
